content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clarksville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirements. Gather your project documentation and timeline—you'll need these details for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Clarksville-based instructors deliver all required contact hours online, letting you learn from home or the office while maintaining your work schedule. Completion satisfies PMI's formal-education requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your training completion certificate and project-experience documentation. Pay the examination fee at that time. PMI will audit and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and guidance to help you study effectively. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Most candidates sit for the computer-based exam at an authorized test center; confirm your preferred location and test date in advance.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you must renew it every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs). PMI offers multiple pathways—training, volunteer work, and self-directed learning all count. Plan your renewal strategy early to stay current and maintain your competitive edge in Clarksville's project-driven market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
